title: LONG TOURS
meta_description: Embark on an immersive long tour through Southern Laos, discovering waterfalls, ancient temples, ethnic villages, and vibrant markets—an unforgettable journey blending nature, culture, and history.

Discover the essence of Southern Laos on a journey filled with culture, scenery, and unforgettable moments 3-Day Classic Experience in Southern Laos Prepare for an unforgettable 3-day, 2-night adventure that gracefully blends the rich tapestry of Southern Laos . Explore the captivating Li Phi Waterfall and the immense Khone Phapheng Waterfall , often called the ' Niagara Falls of Southeast Asia '. Delve into ancient history at Vat Phu Temple before continuing to the refreshing allure of the highlands in Bolaven Plateau . VIEW MORE 6-Day Journey to the Heart of Southern Laos This six-day journey immerses you in a landscape rich with ancient heritage , living traditions, and remarkable natural scenery. You’ll explore towering waterfalls , vibrant highland communities, and serene countryside paths before experiencing meaningful cultural encounters such as traditional ceremonies and local homestays. The adventure concludes with time on a peaceful river island region , where tranquil waterways and gentle village life offer a perfect and memorable finish to your trip. VIEW MORE 3-Day Highlights of Southern Laos A highlight of Southern Laos is this 3-day, 2-night program designed for travelers with limited time. Explore the lush Bolaven Plateau, visiting Tad Fane and Tad Yuang waterfalls and learning about coffee cultivation at Jhai Coffee cooperative. Ascend to the Volcano Summit (Phu Krateh) for a breathtaking 360-degree panoramic view, perfect for sunset. Delve into ancient history at the majestic Vat Phu Temple and experience the serene beauty of the 4,000 Islands (Si Phan Don) . This journey blends natural wonders, cultural heritage, and riverine charm for a complete Southern Laos experience. VIEW MORE 4-Day Southern Laos Escape Embark on a refreshing 4-day, 3-night escape into the enchanting beauty of Southern Laos . Beginning in Pakse, your journey explores the lush Bolaven Plateau 's waterfalls and coffee plantations. Delve into ancient history at the majestic Vat Phou (UNESCO World Heritage Site) . You'll then visit the historic Tomo temple and trek to Phou Asa 's panoramic viewpoint. The adventure culminates in the laid-back charm of the 4,000 Islands (Si Phan Don), where you'll discover peaceful waterways and island life. This escape perfectly blends natural wonders, cultural insights, and peaceful relaxation, offering cherished memories of Southern Laos . VIEW MORE 5-Day Exploring Southern Laos A captivating 5-day, 4-night journey through Southern Laos , discovering ancient history, vibrant cultures, and breathtaking natural beauty. The adventure begins in Pakse, with a full day exploring the Bolaven Plateau's magnificent waterfalls and insightful coffee plantations. From Pakse, you'll travel to Champasak for an invigorating trek through rice fields to unique local sites , culminating at the majestic Vat Phu temple . Conclude your journey with two nights immersing yourself in the tranquil embrace of the 4,000 Islands , discovering its peaceful waterways before your final transfer to the Cambodia border.
